description:
A mountain pass near the Indus, in the winter of the year one thousand and forty. A blind man is led out among a crowd of soldiers. Ten years ago, he was a king. Tonight, they want him to be king again.

The full story: Folio 3: The Blind King Who Ruled Twice — on our channel and on every podcast app.
